items.name: Big-O definition
items.latex: f(n)=O(g(n))\iff\exists\,c>0,\ n_0:\ f(n)\le c\,g(n)\ \ \forall n\ge n_0

items.name: Dominant term rule
items.latex: \text{Keep the fastest-growing term and drop constants: }3n^{2}+5n+2=O(n^{2})
